segments.text:
Verſ. 9.
Hell beneath is moued for thee to meete thee at thy comming, raiſing vp the dead for thee, euen all the princes of the earth, and hath raiſed from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

EVen as before he attributed gladnes to Trees, ſo now alſo by the ſame maner of ſpeaking hee attributes ſpeech to the dead. For he brings them as it were out of their graues, to the end they ſhould deride the pride of this tyrant; and all the words following are nothing elſe in a maner but moſt pleaſant taunts and flouts. For when great kings approch neere a place, people tremble; they go before and receiue them with great pomp and preperations: ſo Iſaiah faines that the dead ſhall goe before this tyrant, who after his death ſhall deſcend into his ſepulchre, that they may do him homage, but yet ſuch as to him appertaineth. Which is as much as if he ſhould ſay, His death ſhall not only be acceptable to the liuing, but to the dead alſo, ſo as they ſhal receiue him honorablie according to his deſerts.
